Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CONCEPT REVIEW storyboard, not production sprites, not atlas.
Create a meticulous landscape 1536x1024 combat animation design board titled "CAI BANG / BONG A - FOUR BEATS", dark warm charcoal background, restrained warm parchment labels and orange rules, generous separation.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED RUNTIME staff hero atlas: identity, costume, compact chibi proportions and wooden staff are immutable. Input image 2 is a supporting director design reference; never use its portrait scale as sprite scale. Input image 3 is the real retained gameplay screenshot for context only.
Keep exactly this boy: dark brown tied ponytail and red ribbons, red layered tunic, pale diagonal collar, dark belt, brown pants/boots. Do not redesign him, no armor, no new hat, no glowing staff replacement. Crisp detailed wuxia pixel-art clusters. Elevated top-down three-quarter orthographic RPG camera; four cardinal facing design, all enlarged pose studies here FACE RIGHT but viewed from above, NOT side-view fighting game.
Board layout: four generous horizontal rows, one row per strike. Columns: "ANTICIPATION" / "CONTACT" / "RECOVERY" / "VFX ONLY". Each character illustration has SAME body proportions, foot baseline and same physically constant-length straight wooden staff. Explicit visibly different body poses.
Row1 "1 THRUST": coil elbows at ribs -> step with two hands driving staff tip straight right at chest height -> withdraw into guard. Separate tiny narrow ember tip streak.
Row2 "2 SWEEP": rotate shoulders back, staff across hips -> broad waist-height horizontal sweep on ground plane -> continue torso turn with staff low. Separate thin red-orange flattened crescent, NOT big solid fire.
Row3 "3 RISING": crouch with tip low on right -> lever shaft upward with two hands, diagonal rising strike, shoulders open -> high guard. Separate thin climbing hooked arc, visually distinct from sweep.
Row4 "4 OVERHEAD": both hands lift staff over head -> full downward chop from above onto ground in front, crouched planted feet -> pull staff back with knees bent. Separate concentrated orange-white impact notch plus short cracked-ground rays, distinct strongest accent but no fire dragon.
Draw twelve clearly differing CHARACTER-ONLY poses (no VFX obscuring hands/staff), four separate effect-only studies. Small clean arrows on annotations show thrust forward, sweep around front, rising diagonal, downward strike. Labels "t0 / t1 / t2 = visual beats only"; footer verbatim "CONCEPT_PENDING_REVIEW | ART DIRECTION ONLY - NO HITBOX OR COMBAT TIMING DECISION". Tiny native-style hero swatch as visual reference only; do not claim measured scale.
No giant portraits, isometric grid, blur, vector graphics, 3D, procedural geometry, spurious weapons, double staff, extra arms, watermarks, fake screenshot. Maintain disciplined body/weapon animation clarity and ample gutters.
